def move(pos, quat=q_side, speed=0.12, settle=2):
    print('move ->', np.round(pos,4).tolist(), flush=True)
    p['move_ee'](pos, quat, speed=speed, settle=settle, max_steps=300)
    print('  ee', np.round(s.ee_pose()[0],4).tolist(), flush=True)

def handle(name, dest_xy):
    obj=s.objects()[name]
    b=np.asarray(obj['bounds'],float); c=np.asarray(obj['position'],float)
    # Grip the narrower tapered lower body from the open front of the rack.
    z=float(b[0,2]+0.030)
    print('\nPICK',name,'center',c,'bounds',b,'grasp_z',z,flush=True)
    p['open_gripper'](steps=12)
    # Orient outside the shelf, align in front, then enter horizontally.
    move([0.30,float(c[1]),z], q_side)
    move([0.555,float(c[1]),z], q_side, speed=0.10)
    p['close_gripper'](steps=24)
    p['hold'](8)
    print('  after close',s.status(),'object',s.objects()[name]['position'],flush=True)
    # Draw the mug through the open front and clear the rack before carrying it.
    move([0.32,float(c[1]),z],q_side,speed=0.10)
    move([0.32,float(c[1]),0.43],q_side)
    print('  after lift',s.status(),'object',s.objects()[name]['position'],flush=True)
    # Carry to an empty table patch; compensate for the actual grasp offset.
    op=np.asarray(s.objects()[name]['position'],float)
    desired=np.array([float(dest_xy[0]),float(dest_xy[1]),float(s.objects()['table']['bounds'][1][2])+(b[1,2]-b[0,2])/2])
    ee=np.asarray(s.ee_pose()[0],float)
    shift=desired-op
    above=ee+shift; above[2]=max(0.39,ee[2])
    move(above,q_side,speed=0.16)
    # Place at tabletop height, then release and retract upward.
    ee=np.asarray(s.ee_pose()[0],float)
    final=ee+shift
    move(final,q_side,speed=0.10,settle=4)
    p['open_gripper'](steps=18)
    p['hold'](28)
    print('  after place',s.status(),'object',s.objects()[name]['position'],flush=True)
    # Retract without sweeping across the placed mug.
    pe=np.asarray(s.ee_pose()[0],float).copy(); pe[2]=max(0.30,pe[2]+0.18)
    move(pe,q_side,speed=0.12)
